command: Synthetic service standards example for learning and verifying Repository Standards

Synthetic Mira service standards example for learning and verifying Repository Standards. Includes a complete service profile, operational guidance, a repeat-safe status initializer, and a separate check. Requires a compatible Repository Standards CLI and Node.js 24 for declared operations. MIT licensed.
